content.caption: Accuracy versus latency on F1, B1 and J for the Base, Base + Reranker and Memory-R1 (GRPO) pipelines, showing p50 and p95 latency for each.
content.description: The chart has three panels titled F1 (↑), B1 (↑) and J (↑). Each plots Accuracy (%) against latency in seconds on a log axis, with a 10^0 tick. Each pipeline appears as a circle for p50 latency joined by a horizontal line to a triangle for p95 latency at the same accuracy. Memory-R1 (GRPO, green) sits at the top-left in every panel, giving the highest accuracy with the lowest latency. Base (blue) has the lowest accuracy with p95 latency extending far right. Base + Reranker (orange) has moderately higher accuracy than Base and the highest latency, at the far right. Approximate accuracies read from the y-axes are: F1 about 45 for Memory-R1, 32.7 for Reranker and 30.4 for Base; B1 about 37.6, 24.8 and 22.3; J about 62.8, 60.0 and 45.8. Exact latency values cannot be read precisely, so they are not recorded.
